card.title: Rank Everything
card.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I planned this picnic, so I get first choice of cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Destination selection outranks transport. You can go second.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked it. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking outranks driving. But I commissioned the cake, so commissioning goes first. I'll take the end piece.

mechanism: A ranks picnic contributions after each disclosure so A's own role still wins the preferred cake piece.
confusable: Unlike comparing contributions fairly, each new ranking must place A nearer the top.
comparison: D67-a shifts planning to commissioning above baking; D67-b shifts troubleshooting to stress testing above the successful fix.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
